top_concerns: LMM-score (GPT-5-mini judge) is the headline metric, with no human-agreement or judge-robustness validation and a risk of self-preference bias
Numerous inconsistencies between tables, text and appendix (identical Claude/GPT-5 rows in Table 5, identical InternVL-3/3.5-8B rows, Seed-1.6-VL 0.81 vs 0.23, text values absent from tables)
Unclear treatment of non-executable outputs: scores likely averaged over different successful subsets, so cross-model comparison and the 'fidelity is the bottleneck' conclusion are unreliable
Level 3 is small (150 tasks, 85 charts), mostly a context-length and execution-failure test, only 5 models, near-zero scores with no variance or confidence intervals
Incremental novelty, LLM-assisted GT code and edit instructions, no contamination analysis, and no failure taxonomy or diagnostic insight
